newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: EC earmarks $3.25 million for Cambodian schools.
newsitem.headline: EC earmarks $3.25 million for Cambodian schools.

text.p: The European Commission on Wednesday pledged $3.25 million in aid to war-torn Cambodia's troubled primary school system, officials said.
The average child in Cambodia completes less than four years' schooling and only a third of children over seven attend any kind of educational institution.

Minister of Education Tol Lah and EC Ambassador Michel Caillouet said the funds would help train new teachers, provide teaching materials and support educational planning, as well as rehabilitate schools damaged by floods late last year.
"The (system) is still frail," said Caillouet, who noted the EC had supported Cambodian schools since 1994.
Cambodia's educational system is plagued by a lack of qualified teachers, strained budgets and corruption, education officials say.
